# README screenshots

Each README uses screenshots of the matching language on [opennavo.com](https://opennavo.com/).

| Language | README | Image directory | Website prefix |
|---|---|---|---|
| English | [README.md](../../README.md) | `en-US/` | `/` |
| 简体中文 | [README.zh-CN.md](../../docs/i18n/README.zh-CN.md) | `.` | `/zh` |
| 日本語 | [README.ja-JP.md](../../docs/i18n/README.ja-JP.md) | `ja-JP/` | `/ja` |
| Español | [README.es-ES.md](../../docs/i18n/README.es-ES.md) | `es-ES/` | `/es` |
| Português (Brasil) | [README.pt-BR.md](../../docs/i18n/README.pt-BR.md) | `pt-BR/` | `/pt` |
| Русский | [README.ru-RU.md](../../docs/i18n/README.ru-RU.md) | `ru-RU/` | `/ru` |
| Deutsch | [README.de-DE.md](../../docs/i18n/README.de-DE.md) | `de-DE/` | `/de` |
| Français | [README.fr-FR.md](../../docs/i18n/README.fr-FR.md) | `fr-FR/` | `/fr` |
| Italiano | [README.it-IT.md](../../docs/i18n/README.it-IT.md) | `it-IT/` | `/it` |
| 繁體中文 | [README.zh-Hant.md](../../docs/i18n/README.zh-Hant.md) | `zh-Hant/` | `/zh-hant` |

Each directory contains the same four views:

- `screenshot-home.webp`: the home page.
- `screenshot-discover.webp`: `/discover`.
- `screenshot-detail.webp`: `/apps/visual-studio-code`.
- `screenshot-versions.webp`: `/apps/visual-studio-code/versions`.

The five additional language sets were captured on 2026-10-08 with browser-use CLI: a 1440 × 900 CSS viewport, device scale factor 2, dark theme, and reduced motion. The resulting 2880 × 1800 PNG screenshots were encoded as WebP at quality 88. Fonts and visible images finished loading before capture; the document language and absence of horizontal overflow were checked on every page. The existing Chinese screenshots remain in this directory.

The German, French, Italian, and Traditional Chinese sets were captured on 2026-10-27 with browser-use CLI using the same viewport, scale, theme, motion preference, encoding, and page checks.

These are captures of the rendered website. App names and embedded screenshots retain their original branding and language; catalog text may fall back to English when a translation is unavailable.
